description.correction: SeatGeek Platform API documents event, venue, and performer data plus event-level listing statistics such as listing count and prices; its public v2 reference does not document retrieval of individual ticket listings.

notes: The legacy official reference still documents the v2 endpoint, client_id authentication, and example request. platform.seatgeek.com remains an official link but redirects to developer.seatgeek.com. Its old 2016 free-access statement is insufficient for current pricing: SeatGeek's 2025 terms allow gated access, fees, and unspecified technical limits. No authoritative CORS policy or numerical rate limit was located.
